prelude: type CmdErr = Unknown{cmd: Str} | MissingArg{cmd: Str}
sig: fn exec(stack: List[Int], cmd: Str) -> List[Int] ! fail[CmdErr]
desc: Execute one command on a stack (the top is the end of the list). "push N" appends the integer N (raise MissingArg{cmd: "push"} if N is absent or not an integer). "pop" removes the top (MissingArg{cmd: "pop"} if the stack is empty). "add" pops two values and pushes their sum (MissingArg{cmd: "add"} if there are fewer than two). Anything else raises Unknown{cmd: <first word>}. Words are separated by single spaces.
tests:
catch exec([], "push x") == []
  | MissingArg{cmd} => cmd == "push"
  | _ => false
